summary: The account03/B06 near-coloop ridge alternative plus its transverse e2 reserve does not force one uniformly conditioned original-coordinate 2x2 pair. Exact target matrices A=[[0,H],[H^T,0]] with H rows u,v/sqrt(N),...,v/sqrt(N), for flat orthonormal u,v, have spectrum {1,1,-1,-1}, a ridge near-coloop with constant total attached 2x2 determinant mass, but each attached ridge minor is O(1/N) and every physical 2x2 curvature magnitude is O(1/sqrt(M)). The same family is uniformly bounded after grouped two-bank product aggregation by QFORM-WEIGHTED-HYPERBOLIC-TWO-BANK-v1.
